svg.title: Hook Cam — Technical Schedule
svg.text: Confirmed vendor data / preliminary system requirements
RV1126B • quad-core Cortex-A53 1.2 GHz • 3 TOPS NPU • 4 GB LPDDR4
SC850SL • 4K at 30 FPS • six-axis ICM-42670-P IMU
16 GB eMMC • microSD up to 512 GB
USB-C OTG • debug UART • CAN ×2 • GPIO ×2
PoE or 12–24 V DC barrel input; 7.4 V battery management supported
0.1–40 m at 90% reflectivity; 0.1–13.5 m at 10% reflectivity
±5 cm from 0.1–5 m; ±1% from 5–40 m; 1 cm resolution
850 nm VCSEL • 3° FoV • Class 1 • 100 klux ambient-light immunity
5–12 V DC • ≤1 W average • UART / I²C / I/O • 3.3 V LVTTL
24 V class / 25.6 V nominal, 8S LiFePO4 target
500–600 Wh target; approximately 20–24 Ah at 25.6 V
BMS • branch fuse • service disconnect • reverse-polarity protection
Field quick-swap enclosure and keyed high-current connector
Select LTE bands, Ethernet ports, VPN, watchdog, temperature and IP requirements
Confirm supply voltage, current, SPL, alarm pattern, duty cycle and relay rating
Confirm standard, injector/switch topology, conversion efficiency and surge protection
Recalculate with measured average load, temperature derating and usable battery energy
Freeze mounting, enclosure, cabling, antenna, LiDAR alignment and maintenance access
Select router, siren and battery pack before electrical schematic and enclosure design.
